try: Start Sophia’s contract from her confirmed quote
how:
1. Open Sophia Wong › "Quotes" and open her quote
2. Click "Send for signature" (or the ⋮ "More options" menu › "Create contract from this quote")
expect: "Choose a contract template" opens with "Interior Design Service Agreement" marked "Default" and already picked, beside the "Agreements" and "Variations" folders
in10: Different from 1.0: started only from the lead drawer

try: Use the studio’s service agreement template
how:
1. Keep "Interior Design Service Agreement" (marked "Default") picked
2. Click "Use template"
expect: "Use template" reads "Creating…" for a moment, then the contract opens as a Draft with a "From template" chip; the top row shows Sophia Wong · 9765 4321 and her quote’s number and total
in10: Different from 1.0: 1.0 kept no contract record

try: Add the quote’s validity date with Insert a field
how:
1. Click at the end of clause 2’s paragraph ("2. Contract sum")
2. Click "Insert a field" › "Studio" and find "GST reg. no.", then click "‹ Studio" to go back
3. Click "Quote" and then "Quote valid until"
expect: Each record shows what it prints for Sophia (or "Empty"); Studio lists "GST reg. no."; a "Quote valid until" chip appears where you clicked
in10: Different from 1.0: more records, each showing its value

try: Jump to a clause from the Outline
how:
1. Look at the "Outline" list left of the page (if hidden, click the list icon "Show outline")
2. Click "8. Defects liability"
expect: The Outline lists every heading of the agreement; clicking one scrolls the page straight to that clause
in10: New in 2.0

try: Make Sophia read to the end and tick before signing
how:
1. Click "eSignatures" in the toolbar
2. Under "Before the client signs", switch on "Read to the end" and "Tick to accept"
3. "The words they tick" already reads "I have read and agree to this document." — replace it with: I have read and agree to the service agreement.
4. Close the panel
expect: The panel lists four fillable fields (Studio / Client signature and initial); both switches stay on and your words are kept
in10: Different from 1.0: only library documents had these checks

try: Ask for a follow-up and a thank-you reminder
how:
1. Click the bell icon in the contract’s header (tooltip "Automation")
2. Switch on "Remind me to follow up"
3. Switch on "Remind me to thank the client"
expect: Both switches stay on, each explaining the task it adds, and the bell icon stays highlighted
in10: New in 2.0

try: Send the contract and copy Sophia’s signing link
how:
1. Click "Send"
2. Check "Client name" and "Client phone (for the code)"
3. Click "Copy link" (not WhatsApp), then close the window with ✕
expect: Sophia Wong and 9765 4321 are filled in; after "Copy link" the status reads "Sent to Client" and a banner says "not opened yet"
in10: Different from 1.0: sent on WhatsApp or a copied link, not SMS

try: Open the signing link as Sophia would
how:
1. Open a new browser tab
2. Paste the copied link into the address bar and press Enter
expect: Studio name and "Secure signing" on top; the agreement carries Sophia’s name and quote total; the card says "Hi Sophia", phone masked except 4321
in10: Different from 1.0: she reads first, then gets the code

try: Check the quote this agreement signs
how:
1. In the card, click "It signs quotation … — view the quote"
2. Look it over, then close that tab
expect: Sophia’s quote opens in its own tab as the client sees it, with "Back to the agreement"; nothing on it can be changed
in10: Different from 1.0: the quote opens beside, not as a step

try: Read to the end and accept the terms
how:
1. Note that "Send code" is greyed out
2. Scroll to the very end of the agreement
3. Tick "I have read and agree to the service agreement."
expect: The card changes to "You’ve read to the end"; after the tick "Send code" can be pressed
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Change the contract while Sophia is signing
how:
1. Click "Send code", type any six digits (e.g. 123456 — stands in for the SMS code), click "Verify"
2. Switch to the studio tab, type a word into clause 1 and wait for "Saved just now"
3. Back in Sophia’s tab, click "Sign agreement"
expect: A message says the agreement was updated while she was reading; the page goes back to the start with the new text
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Sign by drawing, with an NRIC
how:
1. Scroll to the end, tick, click "Send code", type 123456, click "Verify"
2. Choose "Draw" and sign on the pad with the mouse
3. Type S1234567A in "NRIC / FIN (optional)"
4. Click "Sign agreement"
expect: Under the NRIC it reads "Kept as •••••567A"; the sentence above names the agreement and her quote; the card then shows "Signed"
in10: Different from 1.0: type or draw; NRIC optional, kept masked

try: Look at the proof of signing
how:
1. Scroll below the agreement to "Signing record"
2. Click "Download a copy" in the card, then cancel the print
expect: The record lists Sophia Wong, "Drawn by hand", •••••567A, the masked phone, device, times and a fingerprint; the print shows letterhead and signatures
in10: Different from 1.0: on the page, not a PDF certificate

try: See the signed contract locked in the studio
how:
1. Go back to the studio tab and refresh the page
2. Try to type in the agreement or change the title
3. Click "Signing record" in the banner
expect: Status "Signed" with a signed-date chip; the banner says Sophia signed online and it stays signed; nothing edits; the record matches hers
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Check her quote is now signed
how:
1. Close the contract with ✕ — you land back on her quote
2. Look at the status and the chips beside the title
3. Click the "Contract · Signed" chip
expect: The quote reads "Signed"; a "Contract · Signed" chip sits by the title and opens the contract
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Check the two reminders became tasks
how: 1. Open Sophia Wong › "Tasks"
expect: "Follow up on “Interior Design Service Agreement” — not signed yet" is completed; "Thank Sophia Wong for signing “Interior Design Service Agreement”" is due today
in10: New in 2.0

try: See the studio was told she signed
how: 1. Click "Notifications" (the bell) in the side navigation
expect: The newest notice reads "Sophia Wong signed Interior Design Service Agreement"; it opens her Overview with the Move stage window at Won and her contract picked — press Cancel (Won comes in chapter 9)
in10: Different from 1.0: the signed notice takes you to the next step, Won

try: Read the contract’s row and try to un-sign it
how:
1. Open Sophia Wong › "Contracts"
2. Look at the "Signed Copy" and "Sent" columns
3. Click the status "Signed" and try "Draft"
expect: Signed Copy names the signed-online file; Sent shows "Viewed" with a date; "Draft" and "Sent to Client" say "signed by the client" and do nothing
in10: Different from 1.0: Viewed is a date, not a status

scene: Gerald Tan: paper and a pair of documents
try: Record Gerald Tan’s contract signed on paper
how:
1. Open Gerald Tan › "Contracts" › "New Contract" › "Import from File"
2. Type "Signed paper contract" in "Contract title" and upload the PDF
3. Switch on "This copy is already signed"
4. Click "Import"
expect: "Signed contract imported"; it opens with "Signed …" and "Uploaded PDF" chips and a banner "Marked signed on …"
in10: Different from 1.0: the upload becomes a contract, not a lead flag

scene: Gerald Tan: paper and a pair of documents
try: Take back a signing recorded by mistake
how:
1. Click the status "Signed" › "Draft"
2. Read the question, then click "Move back"
expect: "Move back to Draft?" says the signed date and copies are cleared; then the status reads "Draft" and the Signed chip is gone
in10: Different from 1.0: 1.0 never reopened a signed contract

scene: Gerald Tan: paper and a pair of documents
try: Mark it signed again with today’s date
how:
1. Click the status "Draft" › "Signed"
2. Keep today in "Signed on" (attaching a copy is optional)
3. Click "Mark as signed"
expect: "Contract marked Signed"; the banner says it was marked signed today and an Owner or an Admin can move it back
in10: Same as 1.0

scene: Gerald Tan: paper and a pair of documents
try: Try sending a variation order with nowhere to sign
how:
1. Close with ✕, then "New Contract" › "From Template" › "Variations" › "Variation Order" › "Use template"
2. Click "Send"
3. Click "Show me" on the message (or "eSignatures"), then "Insert" beside "Client signature"
4. Close the contract with ✕
expect: Send refuses: "Before you send: There’s no Client signature field — insert one from eSignatures"; after Insert a Client signature box is added where the cursor was — here at the end of the document, since nothing in it was clicked
in10: Different from 1.0: 1.0 only checked for an empty page

scene: Gerald Tan: paper and a pair of documents
try: Send Gerald two documents under one link
how:
1. "New Contract" › "From the studio agreement", then close it with ✕
2. Click ⋮ "More options" › "Send together for signature"
3. Click "Copy link"
4. Click "Send via WhatsApp" — a WhatsApp tab opens; close it, do not send
expect: Both documents are ticked and numbered in reading order; afterwards both rows read "Sent to Client" and "2 documents sent under one link" shows
in10: Different from 1.0: contracts go together; the quote signs through them

scene: Gerald Tan: paper and a pair of documents
try: Sign both documents once, as Gerald
how:
1. Paste the copied link into a new tab
2. Read each document; where asked, scroll to the end and tick, then "Continue" / "Continue to sign"
3. Type 123456, click "Verify"
4. Click "Sign 2 documents"
expect: One document per screen ("Document 1 of 2", progress bar); the final sentence names both; the card ends "All 2 documents signed by Gerald Tan"
in10: Same as 1.0

try: Find Gerald’s contracts studio-wide and delete one
how:
1. Side navigation "Tools" › "Contracts"
2. Type Gerald in the search box
3. On "Signed paper contract": ⋮ "More actions" › "Copy Link", then ⋮ › "Delete" › "Yes"
expect: Only Gerald Tan’s contracts show, with a "Lead" column; "Contract deleted" appears and the row disappears
in10: New in 2.0

try: Check the deleted contract’s link is dead, then restore it
how:
1. Paste the copied link into a new tab
2. Back in Tools › Contracts, click ⋮ "More options" › "Deleted Contracts"
3. Click "Restore" on "Signed paper contract"
expect: The link reads "This link is no longer active"; the list shows Lead Gerald Tan, Deleted by Dane; Restore puts it back
in10: Different from 1.0: deleted contracts can be restored
